errors.evidence: The description states the line ends at the point (2019, 25000), but the figure shows the value for 2019 is clearly above the 25000 gridline, at approximately 26000.

errors.text_span: В участъка между 2012 и 2015 линията има по-голям наклон в сравнение с този между 2015 и 2019 година.
errors.evidence: The description claims the slope of the line is greater between 2012 and 2015 than between 2015 and 2019. Visually, the line is clearly steeper in the later period (2015-2019), indicating a greater slope, not a smaller one.
